data.name: Arasu
data.long_meaning: Arasu is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘aras’, which means ‘lord of the forest’. It is a name that evokes a sense of strength, courage, and connection to nature. This name is perfect for a baby boy who is strong, brave, and has a deep connection to nature.
